iden-green-congregational-church-iden-gr.assessment: Listed in the 9Marks Church-Search directory. 9Marks publishes the directory as a discoverability tool for Reformed Baptist-leaning, congregationalist, expositional churches that self-identify with the 9 Marks of a Healthy Church (Mark Dever). NOTE: Inclusion is user-submitted via 9marks.org and is NOT individually vetted by 9Marks editorial staff. Treat directory presence as a self-attested signal of alignment with the 9 Marks values; confirm independently before publishing.

idlewild-baptist-sbc-matthews-nc.gender_detail: SBC complementarian per BF&M 2000 Article VI.

idlewild-baptist-tampa-fl.assessment: Idlewild Baptist Church is a large SBC multi-campus church in the Tampa area. Led by Pastor Ken Whitten with campuses in Lutz and Tampa. Offers accessible services with ASL, closed captioning, and Spanish translation. SBC affiliation provides accountability. Verify doctrinal specifics.

score_notes.christology: Affirms Trinity, Christ's deity, substitutionary atonement, literal bodily return — orthodox evangelical Christology.
score_notes.scripture: Affirms 'the Bible as the inspired Word of God' — evangelical inerrancy framing.
score_notes.gender: No women in senior pastor or primary teaching pastor roles per staff page. Women serve in supportive roles (Director of Women's Ministry, Director of Communications). Complementarian in practice — yellow (not green because explicit male-eldership framing not articulated on page fetched).
score_notes.leadership: Large pastoral team with Dr. Edgar Aponte as senior pastor; IMB and Southeastern Seminary connections.
score_notes.soteriology: Affirms substitutionary atonement, salvation exclusively through Christ, eternal security, believer's baptism — sola fide Baptist soteriology.
score_notes.cultural: 'Separation of church and state, but not separation of God and government' — civic-engagement framing, conservative-evangelical stance.
score_notes.preaching: Homepage references 'RECENT TEACHINGS' and 'Watch the latest sermon' but does not characterize approach as expository. Yellow stands.
score_notes.mission: SBC churches give through Cooperative Program; Great Commission emphasis standard.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: R44 refetch: Men's ministry link confirmed, routing to https://www.idlewildlegacy.com/men/ — dedicated men's track exists. Keep yellow pending programmatic detail review (upgrade candidate on next audit).
score_notes.denominational: About page and homepage do not explicitly confirm SBC affiliation despite directory listing. Yellow stands pending /about verification.
